name: Scheme for Establishment of Backyard Poultry Units
benefit: 1. 50 chicks, 10 day old reared at Government Hatchery along with two feeders and two water drinkers are provided free of cost to each beneficiary family at their doorstep.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be of 18 to 55 years of age and a resident of Haryana.
   1. There are no mandatory educational qualifications or training requirements.
   1. Any applicant who has earlier availed benefits under any Departmental Scheme for the establishment of a livestock unit will not be eligible for availing benefits under the Scheme.
